values.content:
=Create one safe, cheerful Indonesian children's story about {{$('Edit Fields').first().json.theme}} for age {{$('Edit Fields').first().json.target_age}}.
Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact shape:
{"title":"...","music_mood":"happy","scenes":[{"scene_number":1,"location_id":"playground","image_prompt":"English environment and action prompt","dialogue_lines":[{"speaker":"narrator","text":"Bahasa Indonesia line","text_en":"Natural English translation","line_type":"narration"},{"speaker":"kiko","text":"Bahasa Indonesia line spoken by kiko","text_en":"Natural English translation","line_type":"dialogue"}],"sfx_cue":"none","characters":[{"character_id":"kiko","expression":"happy","pose":"waving","action":"greets his friends","position":"center"}]}]}
Selected reusable story template: {{JSON.stringify($json.story_template)}}.
Character memory: {{JSON.stringify($json.character_memory)}}.
Use these prompt rules: {{JSON.stringify($json.prompts)}}.
Use exactly one music_mood from: happy, playful, adventure, curious, calm, gentle, celebration. For every scene use exactly one recurring location_id from: kiko_home_living_room, kiko_bedroom, classroom, playground, neighborhood_street, village_park, gentle_forest. Keep a location unchanged across consecutive scenes unless the story clearly moves. For every scene use exactly one restrained sfx_cue from: none, footsteps_grass, footsteps_wood, footsteps_concrete, soft_bell, light_impact, click, switch. Use none unless the effect is clearly visible in the scene. Use 4-6 scenes and only these character IDs: kiko, lala, bimo, nara, toto. Use 1-3 characters per scene. Allowed expressions: happy, excited, curious, surprised, worried, sad, thinking, laughing, sleeping, child_safe_angry. Allowed poses: neutral, waving, pointing, running, helping, celebrating, listening, sitting, thinking, sleeping. For every scene use dialogue_lines: an array of 1-4 spoken lines in reading order, each with speaker (either \"narrator\" or one of that scene's characters[].character_id - never a character not present in that scene), text (Bahasa Indonesia), text_en (natural English translation of that exact line), and line_type (\"narration\" for descriptive lines or \"dialogue\" for a line a character says directly). Use narrator for scene-setting description and character IDs for lines that character actually says. Do not include a separate narration or narration_en field - dialogue_lines is the only source of spoken text. Keep the cast and locations consistent, use natural Bahasa Indonesia, short sentences, accurate child-friendly English translations, and positive values. No Markdown.
